mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually) triggers expected Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS above 100,000 monthly) consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 90.0 indicates significant manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.0 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal severe economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue and investment.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative 20-day returns with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production (INDPRO < 85.0) indicates acute supply chain disruption, increasing input costs and reducing corporate output, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 85.0 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).
